uutiset.t: England's All Blacks Tests 'World Cup practice' | 'Ireland still not contenders'
uutiset.s: Head coaches Steve Borthwick of England, Andy Farrell of Ireland and Dave Rennie of New Zealand speak to media ahead of the final weekend of the inaugural Nations Championship.

uutiset.t: Carra: Lammens confidence worrying but Poch will feel Man Utd were robbed
uutiset.s: Jamie Carragher says Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens' confidence is a cause for concern after his howler cost Mauricio Pochettino a first win since taking charge.

uutiset.t: Liverpool latest: Munoz adds to injury concern ahead of derby
Poch denied first Man Utd win by Lammens howler at Sporting
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino was denied a first victory as Manchester United head coach by a goalkeeping howler from Senne Lammens in an incident-packed 2-2 draw with Sporting in the Champions League as Youri Tielemans was sent off late on.

uutiset.t: Isak and Wirtz power Liverpool to easy victory at Club Brugge
uutiset.s: Liverpool recovered from their shock defeat to Fenerbahce in their last Champions League outing to beat Club Brugge 3-0 and improve their chances of a top-eight league phase finish.

uutiset.t: Papers: Liverpool agree deal to sign Senegal teenager Ndiaye
uutiset.s: The top stories and transfer rumours from Thursday's newspapers...

uutiset.t: In-form Stoke see off Millwall to make it five wins on the bounce
uutiset.s: George Hirst bagged a brace as Stoke secured a fifth successive Championship win by beating Millwall 2-1 at the bet365 Stadium.

uutiset.t: Burnley break winless home record as Birmingham win at Turf Moor
uutiset.s: Burnley set a new record for the longest home run without a league win as Birmingham reaffirmed their Sky Bet Championship promotion credentials with a 2-0 victory at Turf Moor thanks to August Priske's strike and Jaydon Banel's own goal.

uutiset.t: West Brom battle to win at Bolton
uutiset.s: Norwegian duo Aune Heggebo and Felix Horn Myhre scored the goals as West Brom boosted their promotion push with a 3-1 Sky Bet Championship win at Bolton.

uutiset.t: Cantwell penalty steers Blackburn past Watford
uutiset.s: New head coach Edward Iordanescu watched from the stands as Todd Cantwell's penalty condemned struggling Watford to a 1-0 defeat against resilient Blackburn.

uutiset.t: Strangest goal ever?! Morrison reacts to BIZARRE Bruno goal!
uutiset.s: Clinton Morrison watches as Manchester United go 2-1 against Sporting Liston thanks to a bizarre goal from Bruno Fernandes.

uutiset.t: 'Where's he going?!' - Morrison reacts to Man Utd double penalty drama!
uutiset.s: Clinton Morrison reacts to the two penalties in Manchester United's Champions League clash with Sporting Lisbon.

uutiset.t: Dubois vs Parker announced for WBO heavyweight title clash
uutiset.s: Daniel Dubois will defend the WBO heavyweight world championship against Joseph Parker on January 30 at Manchester's Co-op Live arena.

uutiset.t: Birmingham ease to victory at troubled Burnley LIVE!
Super League reveals new format, seven-team play-offs, international games
uutiset.s: Super League has revealed a new format, a seven-team play-off system and Magic Weekend and Rivals Round dates, on the same day London Broncos were confirmed as the competition's 15th team for 2027.
